title: Persistent Planar Memory for Video World Models
title_zh: 视频世界模型的持久平面记忆

paragraphs.en: PPMem以平面基元作为视频世界模型的持久3D记忆，实现紧凑、几何显式且跨视角一致的场景生成，在质量上超越以往方法。 Video world models that generate and explore environments at scale need a persistent 3D memory of what they have produced. Plane primitives offer a natural candidate: a compact set of oriented planes captures the dominant structural elements (e.g., walls, floors, facades) of indoor and outdoor scenes, while requiring only 7 parameters per primitive. We present PPMem, a video world model that adopts plane primitives as its persistent 3D memory. PPMem augments a video diffusion transformer with a planar prediction head and a Depth Token Fusion (DTF) module: each autoregressive chunk jointly produces RGB video and planar geometry, which merges into a persistent plane memory that conditions subsequent chunks via rendered depth. The resulting memory is three orders of magnitude more compact than per-pixel point clouds (~100K primitives, 5MB for a full scene), geometrically explicit (metric depth, normals, exportable surfaces), cross-view consistent (jointly predicted by the shared backbone), and adaptive (refined by the merging procedure as generation proceeds). On DL3DV and RealEstate10K, PPMem outperforms prior 3D-grounded world models in video quality while jointly producing metric-scale depth, surface normals, and exportable planar geometry, sustaining coherence across hundreds of frames under large viewpoint changes. Project page: https://hyzcluster.github.io/ppmem.
paragraphs.zh: 视频世界模型需要对其已生成的内容建立持久的3D记忆，才能大规模地生成和探索环境。PPMem以平面基元作为持久3D记忆，实现紧凑、几何显式且跨视角一致的场景生成，在质量上超越以往方法。 平面基元是一个自然的选择：一组紧凑的有向平面可以捕捉室内外场景的主要结构元素（如墙壁、地板、外立面），且每个基元仅需7个参数。 我们提出PPMem，一个采用平面基元作为持久3D记忆的视频世界模型。 PPMem在视频扩散Transformer上增加了一个平面预测头和一个深度Token融合（DTF）模块：每个自回归块同时生成RGB视频和平面几何，并将其合并到持久的平面记忆中，该记忆通过渲染深度为后续块提供条件。 所得到的记忆比逐像素点云紧凑三个数量级（约10万个基元，完整场景仅5MB），几何上显式（度量深度、法线、可导出表面），跨视角一致（由共享骨干网络联合预测），并且具有自适应性（随生成过程通过合并操作不断优化）。 在DL3DV和RealEstate10K上，PPMem在视频质量上超越了以往基于3D的世界模型，同时生成度量尺度的深度、表面法线和可导出的平面几何，并在大视角变化下保持数百帧的连贯性。 项目页面：https://hyzcluster.github.io/ppmem。
